**Threat Summary: Fraudulent Customs Charge Phishing Campaign**

Threat actors are exploiting the recent introduction of EU customs charges on international online orders by conducting smishing and phishing campaigns that impersonate legitimate postal services to deceive recipients into submitting payment details and personal information. This campaign targets general consumers across the EU who are expecting parcels from international retailers, making the lure highly plausible and broadly effective given the widespread awareness of the new customs regulations. threats.ai_summary:
**Miasma Mini Shai-Hulud Supply Chain Attack on ImmobiliareLabs npm Packages**

A supply chain attack dubbed Miasma Mini Shai-Hulud compromised 22 versions of legitimate npm packages under the @immobiliarelabs scope on June 26, 2026, targeting Backstage plugins used for GitLab integration and LDAP authentication. The campaign likely leveraged compromised GitHub Actions workflows to inject malicious code into developer tooling used across CI/CD pipelines, with credential theft as a primary objective. Security teams should prioritize auditing any environments consuming @immobiliarelabs packages, reviewing pipeline integrity, and rotating credentials
